projects.title: Univest — Trading & Investment Platform
points: Architected brokerage order placement & order management — hardened for security, scale, and low latency.
Binary-encrypted WebSocket market-data streaming with auto-reconnect across app-state transitions.
Raised crash-free users 70% → 95% through crash triage and instant hotfix rollouts.
End-to-end mutual funds: custom BSE headless flow (UPI Intent, UPI Collect, net banking, cards), redemption, SIPs, portfolio — 3K+ orders, Rs. 1.06Cr+ processed.
Unified Juspay headless checkout reused across 4 product flows (Pro, Basket, Commodity, MF).
Cold start 5.5s → 2.0s (64% faster) · API calls −50% · app size −10%.
CMS-driven dynamic UI + runtime page builder — homepage & campaign launches with zero app releases.
Custom deep-link system + AppsFlyer OneLink attribution · CleverTap engagement.

projects.title: Scalper — In-House Charting & Trading Terminal
projects.role: Univest · Built from scratch in under a month
projects.metrics: +12% derivative trade share · +8% more with Scalper 2.0 (~20% combined)
points: TradingView-style chart engine built from scratch — custom indicators, drawing tools, pattern recognition, real-time rendering.
Scalper 2.0 trade-from-chart: average position, stop-loss/target, live order & position lines with full order CRUD.
Rendering pipeline optimized for lag-free performance under continuous live tick streams.

projects.title: Self-Hosted Code Push — Shorebird, Reverse-Engineered
projects.metrics: Hotfixes: days → minutes · Rs. 14L+ saved per year
points: Studied Shorebird's OTA update internals — bidiff patching, zstd compression, updater.rs — and built a self-hosted code-push platform for Android & iOS.
Hotfix delivery went from days of store review to minutes, eliminating the commercial licensing cost entirely.

projects.title: FinSight AI — Native Android & iOS
points: AI-driven finance companion built natively on both platforms: stock fundamental/technical insights, an options strategy builder, and one-click trading.
Installed-broker detection personalizes user journeys and onboarding.

projects.title: OI Visualizer — Options Open-Interest Analytics
points: Helps traders analyze Open Interest (OI) across strike prices for options contracts, visualizing market participation and sentiment.
Tracks changes in OI against price movement to surface support, resistance, and potential trend reversals.
Enhanced P&L visualizer: interactive strategy payoff charts (e.g., bull call spread) with max profit/loss, breakeven indicators, and target/expiry lines.
Charts and table views of call/put OI change per strike, with expiry filtering, crosshair tracking, and interactive tooltips.

projects.title: Libgen — Book Search & Reading Platform
points: Entire app built in Flutter with multi-source scraping and aggregation pipelines written in Dart.
Smooth, user-friendly experience to browse and search through any book.
Monetized via LevelPlay ad bidding and RevenueCat in-app purchases.
Quillshelf brings it to iPhone: import EPUB and PDF files, and read with themes, highlights and daily goals.

projects.title: Searchly — File & Torrent Search
points: Fast file search engine that queries many sources at once and groups results by source: torrents, files, books, movies and more.
Light and dark themes, bookmarks for favourite files, and all settings in one place.

projects.title: THE 3:13 FILES — Psychological-Horror Investigation Game
points: A horror mystery played entirely inside the recovered phone of a missing journalist: messages, calls, recordings, mail and an evidence board, all built as a Flutter widget tree with no game engine.
The whole season is data: 963 story nodes as a JSON graph, with a linter that proves there are no dead ends, dangling edges or unreachable branches.
A fear profile picked during onboarding decides how every scare plays out, and a retcon engine rewrites evidence the player has already collected.
The same story engine also exports the season as an illustrated EPUB novel.

projects.title: Don't Wake the Reader — Stealth Platformer
points: A 2D stealth platformer set inside books: move while the Reader reads, freeze when they look up, and reach the bookmark before the page turns.
Built on Flame with tuned jump physics (coyote time, jump buffering, variable height) that runs the same at 60 and 120 Hz.
70 levels across two books, generated and checked by tests with a jump-aware solver and difficulty-curve rules.
Endless mode, Daily Challenge, unlockable characters, and graceful no-op fallbacks for ads, IAP, Play Games and cloud saves.

projects.title: Regina — Daily Crown Logic Puzzle
projects.metrics: 567 levels · Live leaderboard · EN / HI / ES
points: Place one crown in every row, column and colour region without two ever touching. A new 9×9 daily board is the same for every player.
567 bundled levels from a seeded generator, verified in CI, across four packs from 5×5 to 11×11.
Star ratings against par time, streaks, stats, and an all-time leaderboard on Firestore with security rules tested in CI.
Hints that explain the deduction instead of placing a crown, plus Auto-X marking and share cards.

projects.title: GridFill — Polyomino Grid Puzzle
points: Drag polyomino pieces onto the board and cover every cell exactly once, on grids from 4×4 to 7×7.
Deterministic, seeded puzzle engine, property-tested across 10,000 seeds to guarantee every board is solvable.
XP ranks, streaks, a Daily Challenge, hints, undo and a colorblind pattern mode, all playable fully offline.

projects.title: Remote Jobs
points: Helps people find remote jobs across the globe.
Automated pipeline retrieves remote-job posts from X (Twitter) and publishes them to in-app feeds, keeping users linked to fresh opportunities.

projects.title: MBM E-Learning
points: Gives MBM University students semester- and branch-personalized access to comprehensive study materials.

projects.title: Raksha — Emergency SOS Band
projects.metrics: 🏆 Winner — Incubation & Funding Round (SSIP), IIIT Surat
points: ESP32-based women's safety band paired with a Flutter app: a double-press gesture triggers SOS alerts with live location sent to assigned contacts.
Selected for the Student Startup & Innovation Policy (SSIP) at IIIT Surat and secured funding for prototype development.

projects.title: Buckrate — AI Livestock Weight Estimation
points: Computer-vision weight estimator built on image segmentation with custom-trained models.
Cost-effective livestock weight estimation for a Flutter Web livestock marketplace — no traditional weighing scales needed.

projects.title: Weblm — Website AI Chatbot
points: AI chatbot that interacts with and extracts information from any given website, making web-based data conversational and accessible.

projects.title: Greenhouse Monitoring & Control — IoT
points: IoT system monitoring real-time water content, humidity, temperature, and light availability.
Mobile app displays live readings and enables both manual and automatic control of all connected devices.

projects.title: AI Research Assistant — Research Paper Search, Summarization & Chat
points: AI-powered research paper assistant built as a three-tier system: a Flutter mobile app for search and chat, a FastAPI backend for PDF indexing and RAG orchestration, and external AI/search infrastructure such as arXiv, Google Gemini/Vertex AI-style services, and FAISS.
The app lets a user search arXiv, inspect paper details, generate expertise-aware summaries, select up to three papers, and ask citation-grounded questions over the indexed PDFs.

projects.title: Incognito Vault — Save Incognito AI Chats
projects.role: Personal project · Chrome extension + macOS app
projects.metrics: Live on Chrome Web Store & Mac App Store
points: Saves Claude and ChatGPT incognito/temporary chats to Markdown with YAML front-matter, so a conversation that matters doesn't vanish with the tab.
Captures Claude artifacts (HTML/React files) automatically and gives untitled chats meaningful names.
Private local history in IndexedDB — no cloud sync, no analytics — with one-click resume into a fresh incognito session.
Custom dependency-free HTML-to-Markdown parser running in a Manifest V3 service worker and content scripts.

projects.title: Ayuvo — Private AI Health App
projects.metrics: Open source (MIT) · Launching on the App Store and Google Play
points: Nutrition by photo, barcode, voice or text, GPS and gym workouts, health records, medications and a local mirror of Apple Health or Health Connect, in one app.
An AI coach that runs on the user's own API key from one of 15 providers, or on Gemma, Qwen or MedGemma models that run on the phone.
No account, no Ayuvo server and no analytics, crash or ad SDKs: data stays on the phone unless the user sends it to a service they chose.
Native SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose apps sharing one health-data schema, so Export All Data moves a profile between iPhone and Android.

projects.title: SeedFuel — Health Food Brand Website
points: Marketing and ordering site for a naturally sweetened dry-fruit and seed laddu brand — no added sugar, made with dates and homemade ghee.
Pack picker (500 g to 3 kg) feeding a customisable order form, plus story, ingredients, FAQ, and contact sections.
Plain HTML, CSS, and vanilla JS with reveal animations and a config-driven setup — no framework or build step.

projects.title: PushPatch — OTA Updates for Flutter Apps
projects.metrics: Fixes to production in under 5 minutes
points: Ships Dart-only patches to released Flutter apps without waiting on app store review — binary-diff patches applied on next launch.
Staged rollouts from 1%, real-time adoption and device-health monitoring, and one-click rollback.
Available as a desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux), CLI, and web dashboard; self-hostable on your own infrastructure.
